raw_text: Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior Report: Kashmir Anniversary Campaign 2024. Stanford Internet Observatory has documented a network of approximately 2,300 accounts engaged in coordinated inauthentic behavior around the August 5 anniversary of India's Article 370 abrogation. The network exhibits hallmarks of state-sponsored information operations with accounts traced to Pakistani infrastructure, synchronized activation patterns, and shared content pushing fabricated imagery targeting international audiences.
